name: nauth-toolkit
description: Drop-in authentication toolkit for NestJS backends

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "if(!process.env.npm_execpath||process.env.npm_execpath.includes('npm')){console.error('
❌ ERROR: This monorepo requires Yarn, not npm!
Please use: yarn install
');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const coreDist=path.join(__dirname,'packages/core/dist');if(!fs.existsSync(coreDist)||!fs.existsSync(path.join(coreDist,'index.js'))){console.log('🔨 Building @nauth-toolkit/core...');require('child_process').execSync('yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/core build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/core clean && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/core build
scripts.build:all: yarn clean && yarn build:core && yarn build:deps && yarn build:nestjs && yarn build:client && yarn build:providers
scripts.build:deps: yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/database-typeorm-postgres build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/database-typeorm-mysql build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/email-console build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/email-nodemailer build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/sms-console build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/sms-aws-sns build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/storage-database build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/storage-redis build
scripts.build:providers: yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/social-google build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/social-apple build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/social-facebook build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/mfa-totp build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/mfa-sms build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/mfa-email build && yarn workspace @nauth-toolkit/mfa-passkey build
scripts.clean: find packages -name 'dist' -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && find packages -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.lint:fix: yarn workspaces run lint:fix && yarn format
